data.narrative:
Lodge Systems is a pre-seed stage company in Defense & Security led by founder Stuart Lodge. The valuation universe comprises 10 private peers and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) across the Defense & Security sector. Top-tier private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method is not applicable in this case. The sector contains 23 same-sector peers, but the narrow filters—same-stage peers, adjacent-stage peers, and similar valuation-tier peers—yielded insufficient data (0, 1, and 0 datapoints respectively). Three or more comparable observations are required to establish a reliable median benchmark. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial methodological bias given the heterogeneity of Defense & Security valuations across stages and business models.

The analysis cannot proceed to a supported valuation range at this time. A meaningful triangulation would require either (1) gathering additional pre-seed or seed-stage Defense & Security comparables with disclosed valuations, (2) pivoting to revenue or growth-rate multiples if Lodge Systems' financial metrics become available, or (3) conducting a build-up discounted cash flow analysis if forward projections can be substantiated. Key uncertainties include whether Lodge Systems' technology, go-to-market strategy, and team composition align more closely with government prime contractors or commercial defense platforms, which would materially shift appropriate valuation multiples.
